name: Tabloom: Tab & Session Manager
description: Save & restore tab sessions, auto-suspend idle tabs to free RAM, copy or export open tabs, and sync sessions across devices.
author: Muzammil Haneef

content_security_policy.extension_pages: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; object-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self' https: data:; font-src 'self'; connect-src 'self'

save-session.description: Save all tabs as a session

restore-last.description: Restore the most recently saved session

copy-selected-urls.description: Copy URLs of the selected (highlighted) tabs
